"""Single-episode controller. All feedback comes from the RCB client.
Actions are saved before execution; run with 'replay' to execute recorded targets
on an independently provisioned initial episode (never resets this episode).
"""
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot
OUT=Path('/app/output')
class Controller:
 def __init__(self):
  self.r=Robot(); self.s=self.r.spec()
  (OUT/'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(self.s,indent=2))
  self.names=self.s['action_types']['joint_position']['layout']
  self.ranges=np.array(self.s['action_types']['joint_position']['range_rad'])
 def observe(self,tag):
  res=self.r.get_obs(video='none');res.save(str(OUT/tag));return res
 def measured_targets(self,res):
  p=dict(zip(self.s['proprio_layout'],res.meta['proprio']['now']))
  q=[]
  for n in self.names:
   n=n.replace('_A_','_')
   q.append(p[n[:-1]+'1_pos']+p[n[:-1]+'2_pos'] if n.endswith('J0') else p[n+'_pos'])
  return np.array(q)
 def run(self,q,steps,tag):
  q=np.asarray(q); q=np.tile(q,(steps,1)) if q.ndim==1 else q
  a=np.clip(2*(q-self.ranges[:,0])/(self.ranges[:,1]-self.ranges[:,0])-1,-1,1)
  with (OUT/'actions.jsonl').open('a') as f:
   f.write(json.dumps({'tag':tag,'actions':a.tolist()})+'\n')
  res=self.r.submit('joint_position',a,video='none',note=tag)
  res.save(str(OUT/tag)); np.save(OUT/'last_q.npy',q[-1])
  print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in res.meta.items() if k!='proprio'}))
  print('IMU',res.meta['proprio']['now'][-6:]);return res
if __name__=='__main__':
 c=Controller()
 if len(sys.argv)>1 and sys.argv[1]=='replay':
  for line in (OUT/'actions.jsonl').read_text().splitlines():
   row=json.loads(line);res=c.r.submit('joint_position',row['actions'],video='none',note=row['tag'])
   if res.done:break
 else:
  res=c.observe('initial'); print(c.r.status())

"""Robot kinematics derived solely from spec joint axes and locations."""
import json,numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
S=json.load(open('/app/output/spec.json'));JN=S['proprio']['joints'];AX=np.array(S['proprio']['axis']);JP=np.array(S['proprio']['position_m']);AN=S['action_types']['joint_position']['layout'];LIMIT=np.array(S['action_types']['joint_position']['range_rad'])
def arm_names(side):
 prefix='lh' if side=='left' else 'rh'
 return ['torso',side+'_shoulder_pitch',side+'_shoulder_roll',side+'_shoulder_yaw',side+'_elbow',side+'_wrist_yaw',prefix+'_WRJ2',prefix+'_WRJ1']
def arm_fk(side,qs,point=None):
 rr=np.eye(3);tt=np.zeros(3)
 for n,q in zip(arm_names(side),qs):
  i=JN.index(n);v=AX[i]/np.linalg.norm(AX[i]);rot=R.from_rotvec(v*q).as_matrix();tr=JP[i]-rot@JP[i]
  tt=tt+rr@tr;rr=rr@rot
 if point is None:point=np.array([.435,.214 if side=='left' else -.214,.14])
 return rr,rr@point+tt

def arm_q(side,p):return np.array([p[n+'_pos'] for n in arm_names(side)])
def actuator_ids(side):return [AN.index(n if n in AN else n.replace('_','_A_',1)) for n in arm_names(side)]
def ik(side,desiredR,desiredP,start,point=None):
 ids=actuator_ids(side);lim=LIMIT[ids]
 def fun(q):
  rr,pp=arm_fk(side,np.r_[0,q],point)
  return np.r_[5*(pp-desiredP), (R.from_matrix(rr).inv()*R.from_matrix(desiredR)).as_rotvec(), .015*(q-start[1:])]
 sol=least_squares(fun,np.clip(start[1:],lim[1:,0]+1e-5,lim[1:,1]-1e-5),bounds=(lim[1:,0],lim[1:,1]),max_nfev=1000)
 q=np.r_[0,sol.x];print(side,'IK',q,'error',fun(sol.x)[:6]);return q
